parsed.rationale: Both `NowPlayingItem` (in `AppServices`, `Shared/AppServices/Sources/AppServices/NowPlayingService.swift:23`) and `PlaycutSelection` (in `app:iOS`, `WXYC/iOS/Views/Playlist/PlaylistView.swift:23`) are `type-alias-object` records sharing exactly 2 fields — `playcut:Playcut` and `artwork:<ImageType>?` — differing only in the concrete image type (`Image?` vs `UIImage?`). Neither record carries any restraint markers (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app`, `is_codegen` are all false). Introducing a single generic struct `PlaycutPresentation<ArtworkImage>` with fields `playcut: Playcut` and `artwork: ArtworkImage?` unifies both types: `AppServices` can define `typealias NowPlayingItem = PlaycutPresentation<Image>` and `app:iOS` can define `typealias PlaycutSelection = PlaycutPresentation<UIImage>`, or both call sites can migrate directly to the generic form. The generic struct should live in `AppServices` (or a lower-level shared package both targets already depend on) since `AppServices` is the more foundational package.
